ack.auto: Automatic control turned back on in {rooms}

alarm.footer: When the alarm enters {states}, away mode is activated immediately without a grace period. On disarmed or another armed state, heating resumes when someone is home.
alarm.none_selected: No alarm state is selected — the alarm does not put the house in away.

away.desc: Netatmo's own away temperature — the one every valve goes to when the house is empty. The same value as in the Netatmo app.{schedule}
away.in_app_desc: With NET-TRV it can be set from here. It is used by every Netatmo valve when the house is empty.
away.label: Away temperature
away.too_low: ⚠ The away temperature ({away} °C) is lower than the lowest room temperature ({min} °C). Rooms can get colder than the minimum while the house is empty.

card.boost_info: Raises the heat to {temp}°C in all active rooms for {minutes} min, then restores.

cloud.all_down: Netatmo cloud/gateway down — all rooms unavailable

card.no_rooms: No rooms configured in the card
card.unknown_room_title: The room does not exist in Heat Manager — check room_name/climate_entity in the card's YAML
card.valve_offline_title: The room's valve (climate entity) is not responding

auto_off_temp_days.desc: Number of consecutive days above the temperature limit before the whole house is turned off automatically for the season.
auto_off_temp_days.label: Consecutive days

auto_off_temp_threshold.desc: Outdoor temperature above which a day counts towards the run of mild days below.
auto_off_temp_threshold.label: Temperature limit

boost_default_minutes.desc: How long Boost lasts when started without specifying another duration.
boost_default_minutes.label: Default duration

boost_default_temp.desc: The temperature the room is set to when Boost is started without specifying another one.
boost_default_temp.label: Default temperature

door_heat_share_max_reduction.desc: Cap — door heat sharing alone never removes more than this share of the power.
door_heat_share_max_reduction.label: Maximum reduction

door_heat_share_min_neighbor_power.desc: The neighbouring room's own PID power must be at least this before its heat counts as actually delivered right now.
door_heat_share_min_neighbor_power.label: Neighbour's minimum power

door_heat_share_min_temp_diff.desc: How much warmer the neighbouring room must at least be before any reduction happens.
door_heat_share_min_temp_diff.label: Minimum temperature difference

door_heat_share_weight.desc: How much the power is reduced per degree the temperature difference exceeds the limit.
door_heat_share_weight.label: Weight

ff_max_contribution.desc: Cap — weather compensation alone never adds more than this share of the power.
ff_max_contribution.label: Maximum contribution

ff_reference_outdoor_temp.desc: Outdoor temperature at or above which weather compensation contributes 0.
ff_reference_outdoor_temp.label: Reference outdoor temperature

ff_weight.desc: Extra share of power added per °C the outdoor temperature is below the reference.
ff_weight.label: Weight

grace_day_min.desc: How long to wait, after everyone has left, before the house is set to the away temperature during the day.
grace_day_min.label: Day

grace_night_min.desc: The same wait, but at night — typically shorter, since people rarely leave the house in the middle of the night without reason.
grace_night_min.label: Night

issue_escalation_minutes.desc: A status problem (mould, open window, slow heating and more) that has been ongoing for this many minutes sends one push notification.
issue_escalation_minutes.label: Escalate after

manual_trv.desc: Adds a slider and Send button per room — set a temporary temperature directly from the panel.
manual_trv.label: Show manual temperature control in the Rooms tab

min_room_temp.desc: Applies to every room. The PID never sends a lower setpoint to a valve, and the night setback never goes below it. Default 17 °C — a common minimum against mould.
min_room_temp.label: Lowest room temperature

night_end_hour.desc: Time of day (local time) when the room heats to the full target temperature again.
night_end_hour.label: End hour

night_setback_temp.desc: Number of degrees subtracted from the target temperature during the night period. Never goes below the lowest room temperature (Temperature limits).
night_setback_temp.label: Temperature (setback)

night_start_hour.desc: Time of day (local time) when the night setback begins.
night_start_hour.label: Start hour

notify_issue_escalation.desc: Send one notification when a status problem has been ongoing for at least as many minutes as set below.
notify_issue_escalation.label: Escalate long-running problems

notify_mold_risk.desc: Send a notification when high humidity close to the dew point is detected in a room.
notify_mold_risk.label: Mould risk

notify_preheat.desc: Send a notification when pre-heating starts ahead of a person's arrival.
notify_preheat.label: Pre-heating

notify_presence.desc: Send a notification when someone comes home, or everyone leaves.
notify_presence.label: Presence/away

notify_window_warning_30.desc: Send an extra reminder if the window is still open after the time set in «Warning after» above.
notify_window_warning_30.label: 30-minute warning

notify_windows.desc: Send a notification when a window is opened or closed.
notify_windows.label: Notification on open window

pid_kd.desc: Reacts to how fast the temperature is changing. Rarely needed, since TRVs have several minutes of delay of their own.
pid_kd.label: Kd

pid_ki.desc: Corrects a persistent, slow deviation over time. Keep it low — too high gives overshoot.
pid_ki.label: Ki

pid_kp.desc: How strongly the power reacts to the current temperature deviation. Higher = faster but less stable control.
pid_kp.label: Kp

pid_setpoint_margin.desc: Cap on how many degrees ABOVE the room's own target a TRV may be asked to go, regardless of trv_max. Lower it for tighter control, raise it if heating feels too slow.
pid_setpoint_margin.label: Setpoint margin

push.desc: Sent on: window opened/closed, away mode, arrival, pre-heat and valve protection.
push.title: Push notifications

auto_off.footer: Turns the whole house off automatically for the season if the outdoor temperature stays above the limit for the given number of consecutive days — typically relevant in the transition to spring/summer.
auto_off.title: Auto-off in mild weather

boost.footer: Used by the Boost button and {service} when nothing else is given explicitly.
boost.title: Boost — defaults

door_heat_share.footer: Reduces the PID power when an open indoor door leads to a warmer neighbouring room that is actively heating itself. Never changes the room's target — only the power.
door_heat_share.title: Door heat sharing

global.footer: The weather entity provides the outdoor temperature for season, weather compensation, auto-off and night setpoint. Set during setup — cannot be edited from here.
global.title: Global configuration

grace.footer: How long Heat Manager waits, after everyone has left home, before a room is actually set to the away temperature — so a short trip out to the car does not cause needless cooling.
grace.title: Grace periods

manual_trv.footer: Shows an extra control in the Rooms tab for setting a temporary temperature directly on one or all valves — bypassing schedule and PID. For quick adjustments.
manual_trv.title: Manual TRV control

night_setback.footer: Lowers the rooms' target temperature automatically during the night period and raises it again in the morning.
night_setback.title: Night setpoint

notifications.footer: Choose which events send a push notification via Home Assistant's notify service, and/or a spoken announcement via House Voice if it is installed.
notifications.title: Notifications

pid.footer: The PID controller decides how much power each room asks its TRVs for, based on the deviation between the room's current temperature and the target.
pid.title: PID controller

rooms_summary.footer: Read-only overview of each room's climate entity and optional extras. Changed via Home Assistant's reconfiguration of the integration.
rooms_summary.title: Rooms & climate entities

solar_gain.footer: Reduces the PID power in rooms with a lux sensor while the sun is up and the sensor shows light — direct sunshine needs less heat from the TRV.
solar_gain.title: Solar gain

temp_limits.footer: Heat Manager controls the lowest room temperature itself. The away temperature is Netatmo's own and is used when the house is empty.
temp_limits.title: Temperature limits

weather_comp.footer: Adds a proactive power contribution based on the outdoor temperature, on top of the PID's reactive correction — a classic "heating curve".
weather_comp.title: Weather compensation

window.footer: Controls when and how the heating is turned down while a window is open — and when you are told about it.
window.title: Window

solar_gain_lux_threshold.desc: Lux level above which the room counts as getting real sunshine right now.
solar_gain_lux_threshold.label: Lux limit

solar_gain_max_reduction.desc: Cap — solar gain alone never removes more than this share of the power.
solar_gain_max_reduction.label: Maximum reduction

solar_gain_weight.desc: How much the power is reduced each time the room's lux exceeds the limit.
solar_gain_weight.label: Weight

voice.desc: Spoken announcements on: controller pause/off and season change summer/winter.

window_delay_default_min.desc: How long a window must be open before the heating is actually turned down. Applies to every room. Lowered automatically in strong wind or rain.
window_delay_default_min.label: Delay before off

window_off_temp.desc: The temperature sent to the room's valve when the heating is turned down because of an open window. Only applies while the window is open and is independent of the lowest room temperature.
window_off_temp.label: Off temperature

window_warning_min.desc: How long a window must have been open before you get an extra reminder that it is still open — does not affect the turn-off itself above.
window_warning_min.label: Warning after

ctrl.season_title: Change the season mode manually — Auto lets Heat Manager handle the switch

editor.climate_hint: Used to show the current temperature
editor.no_rooms: No rooms yet — click "+ Add room"
editor.room_name: Room name (matches the Heat Manager config)
editor.weather: Weather entity (for the outdoor temperature in the header)

event.window_open_monitoring: Window open in {room} (no TRV — monitoring only)

health.title: Health score — combines battery, mould risk, unavailable devices and heating deviation

rd.comfort_desc: The temperature the room should have when someone is home. Night setback and offset are subtracted from it, but never below the lowest room temperature (Settings).
rd.force_title: Force the room to heat now, regardless of presence and windows (heat_manager.force_room_on)
rd.global_note: Sets {count} rooms with a valve to the same temperature — sensor-only rooms are skipped.
rd.heat_demand_desc: How much heat the PID controller is asking for right now, 0-100%.
rd.netatmo_diverge_sent: ⚠ Netatmo is at {cloud}°C, Heat Manager has sent {ref}°C.
rd.netatmo_diverge_wants: ⚠ Netatmo is at {cloud}°C, Heat Manager wants {ref}°C.
rd.netatmo_setpoint_desc: The setpoint Netatmo itself shows for the room — not necessarily what Heat Manager wants.
rd.radiator_desc: The valve's own reading. It sits on the radiator and typically shows 1-3°C more than the room.
rd.released_note: The extra valves are not controlled by Heat Manager right now — only the primary valve follows the schedule.
rd.reset_title: Remove the temporary change and follow the schedule again
rd.room_temp_desc: The room's actual temperature — from an external temperature sensor if the room has one, otherwise from the valve's own reading.
rd.sent_desc: The setpoint the PID is sending to the valve right now. Can be above the target while the room is still cold. Only shown in normal, automatic operation.
rd.target_desc: The temperature Heat Manager is controlling to right now: the comfort temperature after schedule, offset, night setback and away.
rd.title: Rooms — details
